title: Father God I Wonder
lyrics_original: Father God, I wonder How I
and I am adopted in Your family
And I can never be alone
'Cause Father God, You're there beside me

bible_verses.telugu: ఏలయనగా మరల భయపడుటకు మీరు దాస్యపు ఆత్మను పొందలేదుగాని దత్తపుత్రాత్మను పొంది తిరి. ఆ ఆత్మ కలిగినవారమై మనము అబ్బా తండ్రీ అని మొఱ్ఱపెట్టుచున్నాము.
bible_verses.english: The Spirit you received does not make you slaves, so that you live in fear again; rather, the Spirit you received brought about your adoption to sonship. And by him we cry, 'Abba, Father.'

bible_verses.telugu: మనము దేవుని పిల్లలమని పిలువబడునట్లు తండ్రి మనకెట్టి ప్రేమ ననుగ్రహించెనొ చూడుడి; మనము దేవుని పిల్లలమే.ఈ హేతువుచేత లోకము మనలను ఎరుగదు, ఏల యనగా అది ఆయనను ఎరుగలేదు.
bible_verses.english: See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God! And that is what we are! The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know him.

bible_verses.telugu: మరియు మీరు కుమారులై యున్నందుననాయనా తండ్రీ, అని మొఱ్ఱపెట్టు తన కుమారుని ఆత్మను దేవుడు మన హృదయములలోనికి పంపెను. కాబట్టి నీవిక దాసుడవు కావు కుమారుడవే. కుమారుడవైతే దేవునిద్వారా వారసుడవు.
bible_verses.english: Because you are his sons, God sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, the Spirit who calls out, 'Abba, Father.' So you are no longer a slave, but God’s child; and since you are his child, God has made you also an heir.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for adopting me into Your eternal family and calling me Your child. I wonder at the thought of living a single day without Your loving care, but I rejoice that I am never alone. Thank You for walking beside me in every season of life. Fill my heart with joyful worship as I sing Your praises today and forevermore. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, thank You for adopting me into Your eternal family and calling me Your child. I wonder at the thought of living a single day without Your loving care, but I rejoice that I am never alone. Thank You for walking beside me in every season of life. Fill my heart with joyful worship as I sing Your praises today and forevermore. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Looking back on life before knowing God's love, it is truly amazing how we ever got by without the warmth of His heavenly fatherhood. Through Christ, we are not just created by God—we are welcomed into His family as beloved sons and daughters who will never have to walk alone again. This deep sense of belonging fills our hearts with gratitude and invites us to live in joyful confidence. Today, let your heart rest in His abiding presence and sing praises to the Father who holds you forever.
